gallery.filename: A plaque on the wall of Royal Palace of Bucharest - detail.jpg
gallery.title: File:A plaque on the wall of Royal Palace of Bucharest - detail.jpg
gallery.description: A plaque on the wall of Royal Palace of Bucharest. The text says: "On this site stood the palace of Alexandru Ioan Cuza, whose double election as a ruler, in 5th and 24th of January 1859, led to the unification of Romanian Principalities". According to the language rules introduced during the Communist era, the word "Romîne" ("Romanian") is is written with "î" (it is normally written as "Române").
